meta.purpose: Golden candidate sets with expected orderings (SHELTER_RANKING_ML.md §7). Both shipped weight sets - the hand-set baseline 45/35/20 and the trained v1 30/58.1894/11.8106 - and in fact every weight triple in the range between their per-factor minima (exposure 30, travel 35, accessibility 11.8106), must reproduce these orderings.
meta.derivation: Every ordering below is justified by a non-negative margin at the minimum weights: margin >= 30*dXExposure + 35*dXTravel + 11.8106*dXAccessibility > 0. Rationales quote that margin floor, not the shipped weights, so a future retrain stays honest.
meta.featureVocabulary: exposure is the hazard-facing scalar from the asset (higher = worse); accessibility is 1.0 (verified ramp + washroom), 0.5 (no data, neutral), or 0.0 (stairs-only confirmed).

sets.name: band3 vs band0, same walk
sets.rationale: Min margin 30*0.75 > 22. No minutes make 100-year band 3 worth it.

sets.name: safer wins even at 10 more minutes
sets.rationale: Min margin 30*0.4 - 58.19*0.1667 > 2.3. A 10-minute longer walk buys out of a band 2 shelf; a 15-minute one was not, which the trained travel weight pins tightly.

sets.name: inside the league, the shorter walk wins
sets.rationale: Exposure readings within 0.05 everywhere; the weakest chain margin at floor weights is 30*0.02 + 35*0.0889 = 3.7, the strongest 13.2.

sets.name: verified access beats failed access at level features
sets.rationale: Min margin -30*0.05 + 11.81 > 10. A wheelchair user cannot use a stairs-only shelter at any margin this small.

sets.name: verified beats neutral gap
sets.rationale: Min margin 11.81*0.5 > 5. A gap never outranks a check.

sets.name: marginally closer verified facility wins
sets.rationale: Min margin 11.81 + 35*0.0028 > 11.9. Nearly zero travel delta, accessibility decides.

sets.name: past the travel cap only exposure is signed
sets.rationale: Both x_travel clamp to 0; min margin 30*0.43 > 12. Nothing past the cap buys travel score.

sets.name: equal travel and access: floor separates
sets.rationale: Min margin 30*0.25 = 7.5. The exposure floor exists for exactly this ordering.

sets.name: half the travel time wins inside band 0
sets.rationale: Min margin 35*0.5 = 17.5. Identical exposure, walking time dominates.

sets.name: verified access worth 10 extra minutes
sets.rationale: Min margin 2.1 under the trained travel weight (58.19). Ten more minutes is worth the facility; 15 was not, which is exactly the kind of judgement this fixture pins.

sets.name: worst corner loses to anything moderate
sets.rationale: Both past the cap; min margin 30*0.55 + 11.81*0.5 > 22.

sets.name: ten per cent exposure edge at everything else level
sets.rationale: Min margin 30*0.03 = 0.9. Small exposure differences with zero other deltas must still order; ties never need verbosity.
